exit.vector: slow camera push scale 1.0->1.03 over 3.65s (~8 px/s at frame edges) plus +/-4 px y float on the four grid cards (~3 px/s) and amber/blue pulse rings; no exit tween

entry.vector: empty grid/glow at rest at t=0; line-chart card flips in from +640 px x, -70deg rotateY, z -420 starting t=0.1 (about -750 px/s at onset, opacity ramps 0->1 in 0.35s)
